svg.title: Figure 10. What a micrometre of wire buys in synapses
svg.desc: Figure 10. Two line charts over ten length deciles, both on logarithmic axes. Left: synapses bought per micrometre falls from 13.37 in the shortest decile to 0.11 in the longest, close to the dashed line expected if synapse count did not depend on length at all. Right: synapses on the connection itself stay near flat, a median of 40 in the shortest decile against 37 in the longest, while the mean falls from 349.8 to 66.5. Over all 490,884 connections the rank correlation between length and synapse count is −0.054.
